Fresh Paint & New Flooring! Updated 3BR Duplex in Downtown Killeen

Discover this inviting 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom duplex nestled in the heart of Killeen's historic downtown district. Located at 1116 Massey St, this residence now features fresh paint and flooring throughout, adding a modern touch to its classic charm. Enjoy spacious rooms adorned with durable vinyl flooring, and a galley-style kitchen that offers ample cabinet space—perfect for culinary enthusiasts. Step outside to a generous backyard, ideal for entertaining guests or relaxing evenings. Situated just 1.1 miles northeast of Killeen’s center, this home offers easy access to local amenities, shopping, and dining, all within a vibrant community atmosphere. Experience the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and updated style in this charming duplex.
